detect_scm: detect whether a source directory uses Sapling or Git as its source control manager
commit_changes: commit all pending changes in a source directory with a descriptive message and return the new commit hash
get_current_commit: get the current commit hash for a source directory using either Sapling or Git
goto_commit: navigate to a target commit in a source directory while refusing to go before the anchor commit
check_pending_changes: check if there are uncommitted changes in a source directory using the detected source control manager
